# 0.1.1-beta.16.1

Beta.16.1 is a patch release for Bluetooth power, the raised date, and badge
alignment.

## Fixes

- Bluetooth power uses Omarchy's power helper to turn a soft-blocked radio on
  and to turn it off again (#68). Repeat clicks while a power request is pending
  do not dispatch a reverse action; the display follows observed BlueZ state.
- The smaller date is raised beside the clock again, as before Beta.16. The
  clock keeps its shared baseline.
- Single-digit update and tray badges are exactly centered at DPR 1 in circles
  with odd physical-pixel diameters. Fractional scales retain whole-pixel
  placement with parity-limited rounding.
- Restore application icons for pinned tray apps, with a fallback when no icon is available.
- Restore the selected launcher logo, including Omarchy, Shibumi, and Dragon, without symbol remapping.
- Render the OpenCode usage mark crisply at the size of the other provider icons, so its usage fill reads clearly.

## Compatibility

The 24-plugin suite and transactional installation model are unchanged.
Beta.16.1 retains Beta.16's pinned Omarchy and Omarchy Settings `4.0.4-1`
package and Omarchy `v4.0.4` source baselines with Quickshell `0.3.1-1`.
It does not update Omarchy.

## Install and update

For a new source installation, use the release tag:

```bash
sudo pacman -S --needed python jq curl networkmanager power-profiles-daemon upower xdg-utils libnotify wl-clipboard ttf-material-symbols-variable ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic noto-fonts-cjk adwaita-fonts
git clone https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell.git
cd Shibumi-Shell
git checkout v0.1.1-beta.16.1
./scripts/shibumi-suite install --yes
```

Update an admitted Beta.16 installation from its existing checkout:

```bash
git fetch --tags
git checkout v0.1.1-beta.16.1
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --dry-run
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
./scripts/shibumi-suite status
```

The exact Beta.16 tag and release-merge checkouts are admitted predecessors.
Older supported identities retain their exact revision and payload checks;
an arbitrary checkout with the same version is not admitted. Do not install
or update from `main`, or delete lifecycle state to bypass admission. See the
[installation and recovery guide](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16.1/docs/install.md).
AUR publication remains deferred; use the source workflow above.

## Downgrade warning

**Downgrade:** Beta.15.4 and older cannot read V1 layouts with parked widgets
(`order.parked`). They reset the V1 order, roles and splits to defaults; other
settings and V2 stay. `uninstall --keep-settings` does not prevent this. Before
downgrading, back up `~/.config/omarchy/shell.json` and `~/.local/state/shibumi/`.
Details: [Backup before downgrade](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/blob/v0.1.1-beta.16.1/docs/install.md#backup-before-downgrade).

## Known limits

- The power helper affects all Bluetooth radios, not only the displayed
  adapter, and cannot clear a hardware rfkill block.
- Badge digits are exactly centered at DPR 1; fractional scales can leave a
  half-pixel offset.
